export.heading: Export
export.hint: A full backup includes tasks, lists and events and can be imported to restore them exactly. CSV is for viewing in a spreadsheet, but has no ids.
export.empty: There is no data to export.

import.heading: Import
import.plan: Merge preview: {{added}} added · {{updated}} updated · {{skipped}} skipped; replace preview: {{added}} added · {{removed}} removed
import.notWritable: The write port is not connected yet, so importing is unavailable (you can still preview the validation result).
import.confirmReplace: Replace import deletes every current task, list and event and keeps only what is in the backup. This cannot be undone.
import.confirmMerge: Merge import adds missing records and overwrites existing records with the same id when the backup's copy is newer.
import.discard: {{tasks}} in the current data are not in this backup and will be lost permanently after a replace. Export a JSON backup first just in case.
import.discardWithDone: {{tasks}} in the current data are not in this backup ({{done}} completed) and will be lost permanently after a replace. Export a JSON backup first just in case.
import.notWritableTitle: The write port is not connected yet

reset.heading: Delete all data
reset.hint: The sample data is only there to make the features visible at a glance. To start with your own content, clear it first. This deletes every task, list and event, including the ones you added yourself; it cannot be undone. If you want a copy, export a JSON backup above first.
reset.confirm: This deletes every task, list and event and cannot be undone. The sample data will not come back; you can start recording your own schedule right away.
reset.loss: About to delete: {{tasks}} · {{lists}} · {{events}}. Export a JSON backup first just in case.
